Ye skills sab mukammal nahi hain.
text.Some of the 31 skills are rough around t: 31 skills mein se kuch abhi adhoore hain. Ye jaan bujh kar aisa hai:
text.you fix and extend them by describing wh: aap sirf ye batayein ke aap kya chahte hain, aur aap inhe theek aur behtar karte hain
text.. You never write code. You say what is: . Aap kabhi code nahi likhte. Aap batate hain ke kya kharab hai ya kya add karna hai, aur aapka agent wo karta hai, test karta hai, aur aapko result dikhata hai.
text.What vibe coding actually means: Vibe coding ka asal matlab kya hai
text.Normally, making software better means a: Aam tor par software behtar karne ka matlab hota hai ke developer code padhe aur us mein change kare. Yahan aap ye step skip karte hain.
text.You describe the problem in normal words: Aap masla apne aam alfaz mein batate hain, aur agent padhna aur change karna khud karta hai.
text.A skill is just a written-down set of in: Skill sirf likhi hui hidayat ka ek set hai jise aapka agent follow karta hai. Is liye kisi skill ko behtar karna coding ka kaam nahi, ek baat cheet hai. Aap kahte hain “ye hamesha fail hota hai jab koi ise Robinhood link deta hai”, aur wo ja kar usay theek kar deta hai.
aap jo skill behtar karte hain wo behtar hi rehti hai. Agli bar wahi kaam aaye to agent ko jawab pehle se pata hota hai.
text.This runs on the same subscription you a: Ye usi subscription par chalta hai jo aapne pehle se set up ki hui hai. Lambe kaam baat cheet se zyada usage lete hain, is liye pehle kuch kaam ke baad apna usage page dekhein, phir iski fikar chhor dein.
text.In plain English, in Discord. If you can: Aasan alfaz mein, Discord mein. Agar aap kisi insaan ko bata sakte hain, to yahan bhi bata sakte hain.
text.It reads the skill, works out what to ch: Ye skill padhta hai, samajhta hai ke kya change karna hai, aur change kar deta hai. Ise kahein ke ek line mein bataye ke kya kiya.
text.Say “test it and show me the output”. Th: Kahein “test karke mujhe output dikhao”. Ye wo step hai jo log skip kar dete hain, aur asal mein yahi sab se zyada ahem hai.
text.Repeat until right: Jab tak theek na ho, dohrayein
text.If it is not right, say what is still wr: Agar theek nahi hua, to batayein ke ab bhi kya masla hai. Do ya teen round aam baat hai.
text.An agent can tell you it finished someth: Agent aapko bata sakta hai ke kaam mukammal ho gaya, halanke wo chalta nahi. Hamesha asal output, asal error, ya asal link maangein. Agar wo aapko dikha nahi sakta, to kaam mukammal nahi hua.
text.Do these in order the first time. They t: Pehli bar ye tarteeb se karein. Ye das minute lete hain aur aapka setup ban jata hai.
text.Find out what needs work: Pata karein kis kaam ki zaroorat hai
text.@yourbot save what you just worked out a:
@yourbot jo aap ne abhi kaam kiya usko skill ke tor par save karein taake aap yeh dobara kar sakein bina mujhe samjhane ke

@yourbot jo steps aap ne abhi liye wo likh dein taake agli baar bhi isi tarah kaam kare
text.When one of them breaks: Jab in mein se koi ek toot jaye
text.This is the most common thing you will d: Yeh sab se aam cheez hai jo aap karenge, aur yeh bilkul normal hai. Kuch error deta hai, aap error wapas paste karte hain, aur wo ise theek kar deta hai.
Poora error paste karein, summary nahi.
text.The ugly wall of text is exactly what it: Yeh bad-soorat text ki deewar hi asal mein wahi cheez hai jiski zaroorat hai. Ise trim karna hi fixes ko ek ke bajaye chaar koshishon mein badal deta hai.
Agar yeh zyada kharab ho jaye, rollback maangein.
text.“Go back to how it was” is a legitimate: “Wapas jaise pehle tha waisa kar dein” ek jaiz aur kaam ka prompt hai. Bade changes se pehle ise ek copy save karne ke liye kahein taake yeh hamesha mumkin ho.
text.The 31 skills are a starting point. The: 31 skills sirf shuruaat hai. Asal value apne skills add karne mein hai, un kaamon ke liye jo aap baar baar karte hain.
text.Turn every repetitive thing into a skill: Har repeat hone wali cheez ko skill bana dein.
text.If you have explained the same thing twi: Agar aap ne ek hi baat do baar samjhai hai, to wo ek skill hai. Aap ko teesri baar kabhi samjhana nahi parega.
text.Build a whole small thing: Ek chhoti si poori cheez banwayein
text.Same idea, bigger. You can have it build: Wahi idea, bara roop. Aap ise ek kaam karta page banwa kar online dalwa sakte hain, aur isi ke liye setup guide ka Vercel wala hissa hai.
text.If it says the site is up, ask for the U: Agar wo kehta hai ke site up hai, to URL maangein aur khud kholein. Yeh ek aadat is tarah ki ghaltiyon ka zyada tar hissa pakad leti hai.
text.Phrases that work: Wo phrases jo kaam karte hain
text.“show me your plan before you start”: “shuru karne se pehle mujhe apna plan dikhayein”
text.You see what it intends before it does a: Kuch karne se pehle aap dekh lete hain ke uska irada kya hai, aur use redirect kar sakte hain
text.“test it and show me the output”: “ise test karein aur mujhe output dikhayein”
text.The difference between a real fix and a: Asli fix aur ek yaqeen se bhari baat mein farq
text.“explain what you changed, in one line”: “ek line mein batayein ke aap ne kya change kiya”
text.You stay in control without reading any: Aap koi code parhe baghair control mein rehte hain
text.“don’t spend anything / don’t change any: “abhi kuch kharch na karein / abhi kuch change na karein”
text.It does the thinking without touching yo: Yeh sochne ka kaam karta hai bina aap ke paise ya files ko chhue
text.It strips the clever stuff and leaves so: Yeh chalak cheezein nikaal deta hai aur kuch aisa chhor deta hai jise aap follow kar sakein
text.“I don’t understand this, explain it lik: “mujhe yeh samajh nahi aata, ise aise samjhayein jaise main naya hoon”
text.“go back to how it was”: “wapas jaise pehle tha waisa kar dein”
text.An undo, when a change made things worse: Ek undo, jab kisi change ne cheezein kharab kar din
text.“save that as a skill”: “ise skill ke tor par save karein”
text.It becomes permanent, and you never expl: Yeh hamesha ke liye reh jata hai, aur aap ko dobara kabhi samjhana nahi parega
text.Never paste a private key: Private key kabhi paste na karein
text.into a chat with an agent, or anywhere e: agent ke saath chat mein, ya kisi aur jagah. Agar aap ne kabhi kiya hai, to us wallet ko jala hua samjhein aur us mein jo kuch hai wo nikal lein.
Bade changes se pehle plan maangein.
text.“Show me the plan first” costs you ten s: “Pehle plan dikhayein” aap ke das second leta hai aur ek badi museebat bacha leta hai.
text.Three improvements at once means you can: Teen improvements ek saath ka matlab hai aap nahi bata sakte kis ne ise torha.
Apne paise ko ek “nahi” ke peeche rakhein.
text.Say “don’t spend anything without asking: “mere poochhe baghair kuch kharch na karein” kahein aur wo nahi karega.
Gehrai mein jaane se pehle backup lein.
text.Ask it to save a copy of your skills fir: Pehle apne skills ki copy save karne ke liye kahein: “mere skills folder ki copy kisi mehfooz jagah rakh dein”.
text.If it claims success and you cannot see: Agar wo kamyabi ka dawa kare aur aap use dekh nahi sakte, to wo asli nahi hai.
text.All of this needs one thing: Is sab ko ek cheez chahiye
text.The subscription, about $10 a month, run: Subscription, taqreeban $10 mahina, deepseek v4.1 flash chala raha hai. Yeh waqai bahut zyada usage deta hai, aur isi wajah se is tarah ka back-and-forth aap din bhar kar sakte hain bina meter dekhe.
text.Nothing here is financial advice. If you: Yahan kuch bhi financial advice nahi hai. Agar aap kisi skill ko behtar karte hain, to behtar version aap ka hai.
